headline: Nigerian Navy Arrests 259 Over Oil Theft and Destroys Illegal Refineries
summary: The Nigerian Navy arrested 259 suspects, destroyed 168 illegal refining sites, and recovered 7.48 million liters of stolen crude oil over the course of a year.
why: Crude oil theft and illegal refining directly impact national output and state revenues in major petroleum-exporting nations, affecting global supply reliability.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Crackdowns on oil theft affect domestic security and the protection of oil infrastructure.
